Rector of Aston Sandford, and author of a biblical commentary The Holy Bible, containing the Old and New Testaments, with Original Notes and Practical Observations 4 vols (1788-1792)

CMY had incorrectly stated in [Pioneers and Founders](/book/90), 96, that Thomas Scott was a Baptist.
